resolved_intents.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is displayed
Get entered tell your experience value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to 2000 characters
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should retrieve the entered text from the feedback text field using get_entered_text(), verify that the length of the text does not exceed the expected maximum character limit (default 2000), and assert that if more characters were input, the text was properly truncated to exactly the maximum allowed length. The method should raise an assertion error if the text length exceeds the maximum or if truncation did not occur as expected.
